description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to audio spectral analysis and volume control, including retrieving spectral data and setting volume without smoothing.

methods.name: LVM_GetSpectrum
methods.description: Retrieves spectral information at a specified audio time, updating peak data if conditions are met.

methods.name: LVM_SetVolumeNoSmoothing
methods.description: Sets the output volume directly without smoothing, applying control parameters.
